_about: The lists the conflict search's name matching reads (src/name_match.py, rule 4): words that are the same name although they are not spelled alike. Each list is groups of names that are one name; a word in a group matches every other word of that group (a nickname matches the names it is short for, not the other nicknames of another name). Accents and capitals do not matter (they are folded away before comparing). The spelling rules in src/name_match.py already catch most variants (Sousa and Souza, Luis and Luiz, Henrique and Enrique); these lists are for what a rule cannot know.
_format: Hand-formatted, one group to a line, so a reviewer reads it as a list: edit it by hand, never re-dump it. It is not a register file, so the register's byte-for-byte re-dump check (schemas/maintenance.json) does not apply to it.
_source: Compiled by the product's builder on 10/03/2026 from common Portuguese, Spanish, Haitian Creole and French naming practice; not from an official source (there is none for nicknames). Each group is reviewed by a native speaker of the language before a release (schemas/maintenance.json, conflict_matching): a wrong group makes two different people look alike, a missing one hides a real match.
